opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with guests, filters and sort
opportunities.description: On Kayak Stays, search hotels for a {destination} between {check_in} and {check_out} for {rooms} rooms / {adults} adults / {children} children (with child ages), optionally apply filters such as review score, hotel class, amenities and style, then sort by price (low to high).
steps: Open Kayak and click 'Stays' (Search for hotels) in the left nav
Type the destination in 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark' and pick the matching suggestion
Open the date picker and click the check-in date, then the check-out date
Open 'rooms, guests' and use the Increment/Decrement buttons to set rooms, adults, children; set each child's age
Click the search button (or 'Update' if already on results)
On results, apply any filters: review score, hotel class stars, freebies (e.g. Free internet), Style (e.g. Family), Amenities (e.g. Air-conditioned)
Click 'Sorted by' and choose 'Price (low to high)'

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27 – Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 adults (set on results page); sort Price low to high
Santa Fe, New Mexico; Jun 16 – Jun 18; 2 rooms, 3 adults

Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6 – Jun 10; 2 rooms, 3 adults, 1 child age 7; review 8+, 3 stars, Free internet, Family style, Air-conditioned; sort Price low to high (interrupted by a Qatar flight-status lookup)
Los Angeles, CA (City); May 21 – May 23; 1 room, 2 guests; hotel class 5 stars

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On qatarairways.com, search one-way flights (regular or via Qatar Stopover) from {origin} to {destination} on {depart_date} for a given passenger mix and cabin class, then select the cheapest fare for each leg.
steps: Open the Qatar Airways home/destination page booking widget (Flights or Qatar Stopover tab)
Type the origin city in 'From' and choose the airport suggestion
Type the destination city in 'To' and choose the airport suggestion
Click the 'Depart' date field, pick the date and click Continue
Click 'Passengers / Class' and adjust adults, children and infants with +/-; select Economy or Premium (Business/First); click Confirm
Click 'Show flights'
On the results page, click the fare for the desired flight and click 'Select fare' (repeat for each leg/segment)

instances.values: Qatar Stopover; Colombo CMB → New York JFK; one-way 24 Jun 2023; 2 adults, 1 child, 0 infants; Business; selected Business Comfort on both legs (interrupted by IGN browsing)
Via Explore > Africa > Durban; Doha DOH → Durban DUR; one-way 28 May 2023; 2 adults, 1 infant; Economy; selected QAR 4,980 fare, Economy Comfort

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways partner hotel search (Booking.com)
opportunities.description: From Qatar Airways' Book > Hotels menu, search Booking.com partner hotels in {destination} for {check_in}–{check_out} with a guest/room count, then sort or filter results and open a property.
steps: On qatarairways.com click 'Book' in the header, then 'Hotels'
On the Booking.com partner page, type the destination and pick the suggestion
Open the date picker, navigate months, then click check-in and check-out dates (or use the ± days option)
Click Search
Optionally adjust adults/children/rooms on the results page and click Done, then Search
Apply filters (e.g. neighbourhood, star rating, facilities) or change 'Sort by' to 'Price (lowest first)'
Click 'See availability' on the chosen hotel, then 'Reserve'

instances.values: Las Vegas, Nevada; Apr 10 – Apr 16, 2023; 2 adults, 1 room; sort Price (lowest first)
Washington, DC; Jun 5 – Jun 6, 2023; 4 adults, 2 rooms; filters Downtown DC, 5 stars; opened The St. Regis Washington and clicked Reserve
